notes.title: Pythagoria v1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Major update to the game just went live.

Visual Rework
Most of the puzzles were redrawn to remove "visual inconsistency" to represent shapes slightly more precisely; all the puzzles that couldn't be represented more accurately because of balancing the game were left untouched.

I'd like to encourage players who had problems with visual issues to try the updated version of puzzles.

Trading Cards

Trading Cards are available now.

Complete list of other big changes made this week

     Extended version of help with new pages added;
     Added windowed mode;
     Pencil drawing tool fix for Radeon graphic cards.

I want to thank everyone for the great feedback, patience and support. 
Rock on, and enjoy experiencing Pythagoria!
